title: Seismic Design Category D.
officialText: Composite structures are permitted in Seismic Design Category D, subject to the limitations in Section12.2.1 of ASCE 7, where substantiating evidence is provided to demonstrate that the proposed system will perform as intended by AISC 341, Part II. The substantiating evidence shall be subject to the commissioner’s approval. Where composite elements or connections are required to sustain inelastic deformations, the substantiating evidence shall be based on cyclic testing.
